root_idea.summary: The root has two principal branches: intelligible speech and physical wounding. The Quranic vocabulary chiefly develops the speech branch.
root_idea.development: The speech branch extends from meaningful utterance to the word, statement, discourse, and divine pronouncement; the other branch denotes a wound or perceptible injury. A rare, tentative usage also applies كَلَامٌ to rough or hard ground.

senses.definition: To speak to, address, or communicate verbally with someone.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quran uses the form for direct or mediated address, including divine speaking to a human being. Its passive occurrence describes someone being spoken to; this is a voice variation of the same lexical action.
The Quranic Form V use presents the subject as speaking; the object or addressee may be supplied by context rather than by the verb itself.

senses.definition: Speech, spoken words, or discourse, including the meaning conveyed by an utterance.
senses.usage_conditions: In Quranic usage it can denote words or speech attributed to God, as well as speech that is heard, transmitted, or referred to collectively. The noun may cover a saying or discourse rather than only a single word.

senses.definition: An intelligible expression or proposition: a word, saying, sentence, assertion, or expressed opinion.
senses.usage_conditions: The singular denotes one expression or statement; the merged plural forms denote multiple words or statements. The Quran also uses the noun for a complete expressed proposition rather than merely an isolated lexical word.

senses.definition: A divinely established pronouncement, promise, command, judgment, or decree.
senses.usage_conditions: In constructions such as “the word of your Lord” or “the word of punishment,” the noun refers to an enacted divine determination, promise, revealed decision, or binding outcome, not necessarily to a single spoken utterance.

senses.definition: The “Word” as a designation of Jesus, associated with his coming into being by God’s command and with the guidance conveyed through him.
senses.usage_conditions: This specialized Quranic usage occurs in the expression describing Jesus as a word from God and as His word cast to Mary.

senses.definition: Speaking to someone; direct verbal address or communication.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quran uses the verbal noun for divine speaking to a human being, especially in the construction describing God’s modes of communicating with human beings.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To converse with, address, or speak with another person.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form III reciprocal or interactive construction, distinct from the ordinary intransitive Form V use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To speak on behalf of someone, or to express something for him.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized Classical use of the Form V verb; it is kept separate from the Quranic general sense of speaking.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To speak, talk, or discourse with one another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reciprocal Form VI construction in which the participants speak to each other.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A wound or perceptible physical injury; wounds collectively.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This belongs to the root’s distinct injury branch rather than the speech branch; the effect of the injury is treated as perceptible, especially visually.
A rare and explicitly tentative Classical usage reported in the root discussion.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A part or opening of a bow, and a corresponding part of a waterskin.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The supplied lexical evidence records these as separate object-specific uses of this headword.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A loquacious, articulate, or eloquent person.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used as a personal description, especially in the expression for an articulate man.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Muslim theological science concerning God’s being and attributes, creation and restitution, and related doctrinal questions.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical compound meaning, distinct from ordinary speech or discourse.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A Muslim theologian or practitioner of the science of kalām.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical personal noun derived from the theological meaning of علم الكلام.

lane_unit_coverage.note: General speaking and the specialized speaking-for sense are retained.
Word, expression, proposition, and assertion branch.
General noun for sayings and words is covered by the Quranic speech sense.
Speech, talk, discourse, saying, and sentence are covered by the speech sense.
Grammatical account of a quasi-verbal-noun usage; no independent lexical branch.
Technical noun for a Muslim theologian.

cautions: The evidence distinguishes the speech and wound branches of كلم; they should not be treated as one semantic development.

Interpretations of Quranic كلمة in divine constructions include revelation, promise, command, decree, judgment, and established outcome; these are grouped under one constructional sense rather than asserted as a single exclusive referent.
The supplied Lane supplement includes كُلْيَةٌ under this root record; it is retained under its own headword and object-specific meaning rather than being assimilated to the speech vocabulary.
